pokedexEntries.rb: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

pokedexEntries.ye: A gentle and kindhearted POKéMON that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.go: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

pokedexEntries.si: Few in number and difficult to capture, it is said to bring happiness to the trainer who catches it.

pokedexEntries.cr: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.

pokedexEntries.rs: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

pokedexEntries.fr: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

pokedexEntries.lg: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch one.

pokedexEntries.em: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

pokedexEntries.di: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

pokedexEntries.prl: It lays several eggs a day and won’t share them with those who have evil in their hearts.

pokedexEntries.pt: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

pokedexEntries.hg: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

pokedexEntries.ss: Being few in number and difficult to capture, it is said to bring happiness to the Trainer who catches it.

pokedexEntries.bw: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

pokedexEntries.x: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

pokedexEntries.y: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

pokedexEntries.oras: Chansey lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.

pokedexEntries.su: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.mo: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they’re also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

pokedexEntries.us: It seems that other Pokémon’s efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

pokedexEntries.um: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sw: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It’s used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

pokedexEntries.sh: This species was once very slow. To protect their eggs from other creatures, these Pokémon became able to flee quickly.

pokedexEntries.bd: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

pokedexEntries.shp: It lays several eggs a day and won’t share them with those who have evil in their hearts.

pokedexEntries.la: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured. These eggs are so nutritious that they’ve been nicknamed “doctors’ doubles.”
